name: sitare-erp
description: Sitare University ERP — runs the API and the web client together

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta -p "[{name}]" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.use: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta -p "[{name}]" "npm --prefix server run start" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
